name: a-pidoc
description: A Pi-powered full-stack Agent Harness for API debugging, contract migration, and trace evaluation.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:web
scripts.serve: npm run build --silent && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli/index.js serve
scripts.test: npm run build --silent && npm run test:unit
scripts.eval:offline: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli/index.js eval --mode offline
scripts.eval:live: npm run build --silent && node --env-file=.env dist/src/cli/index.js eval --mode live
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run eval:offline
